revision_summary: Two timestamp errors must be corrected: the appointment_set script_coverage entry quotes ('we can do a 04:30 or 5PM. Is that late enough for you?' and 'I think for about, you know, five would be would be better.') are both mis-timestamped at 05:44 — the actual timestamps are approximately 06:03-06:11 (rep) and 06:13-06:19 (customer). Update ts/end_ts fields accordingly. Additionally, Stage 3 missed a significant protocol issue: the customer confirms his wife is a co-owner on the title at 02:04 ('Is there anyone else on the title of the home with you?' / 'Yes. My wife.'), but the rep never invites the wife onto the appointment itself per protocols.spouse_decision — she is only ever referenced as the person who needs to locate the bill. This should be added as a cherry_pick_moment (protocol miss, schema_reference: protocols.spouse_decision) and considered for coaching_focus given the schema explicitly flags this as a high-priority pattern with positive/negative call examples already on file. Minor: soften the confidence in bill_anchor_audit and interest_reason_audit reasoning — the '$150 actual bill' and 'likely bill-pain' inferences are plausible but should be flagged as inferences, not stated as probable fact.
